title: EaW/FoC LSP schema - metafile registry
description: Shape of eaw/meta/metafiles.yaml and foc/meta/metafiles.yaml. Mirrors YamlMetafileFile/YamlMetafileEntry. Drives file-type registration: which game files hold which object types.

scannedDirectories.description: Directories the engine walks, taking every file it finds. Files here are loaded for their location, so no registry names them.

note.description: One thing worth saying about this element, and what sort of thing it is. The kind decides the severity the editor shows and ranks the note against its siblings; it is not the note's order in this list.

kind.description: BuggedInEngine: accepted by the parser but does nothing, or the wrong thing - an error. Deprecated: worked once, something replaced it. Untested: believed correct, never verified against the shipped corpus. Remark: a caveat with nothing to act on. Since: the version this appeared in, carried in 'value'.

value.description: What the kind carries besides prose - the version, for Since.

notes.description: Everything worth saying about this element. Replaces the deprecated/untested/availableSince fields of schema 1.x.

path.description: Game-relative directory, lowercase with forward slashes and a trailing slash (e.g. data/xml/ai/goals/).

types.description: Object types the files in this directory contain, where the schema knows them.

path.description: Game-relative path, lowercase with forward slashes (e.g. data/xml/gameobjectfiles.xml).

metaFileType.description: fileRegistry = lists other files; directContent = holds the objects itself; singleton = one well-known file; special = needs bespoke handling.

types.description: Object types the registered files contain.
